name: SKLZ Golf Alignment Sticks
description: A simple reference for checking your target line and ball position at the range.
why: Consider these if your setup changes from shot to shot. A spare club laid safely on the ground can also provide an alignment reference.

name: PuttOUT Premium Pressure Putt Trainer
description: A folding putting target with a ramp and a small pace-control target.
why: Consider it if you want feedback during short-putt practice at home. You still need a suitable rolling surface.

name: Callaway Chip Shot Chipping Net
description: A portable target for structured chipping practice.
why: Consider it if a visible target helps you practice regularly. It does not reproduce how a ball releases on a real green.
